reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is factually correct: line 328 of peerdas_helpers.nim accesses cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j] without validating cell_proofs.len >= blobs.len * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB. 01e property PROP-57888860-pre-006 (file: outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json) states: 'Proof slicing indices in cells_and_kzg_proofs_construction must always be within blobs_bundle.proofs bounds.' However, 01e itself classifies this property as attacker_controlled=false, bug_bounty_scope='conditional', exploitability='conditional'. Both identified attack paths are out-of-scope: (1) REST API path (/eth/v2/beacon/blocks at rest_beacon_api.nim:1108) requires publicly exposed Beacon API, which BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json explicitly excludes under 'out_of_scope.components' and 'conditional_scope.publicly_exposed_api'. (2) Engine API path (beacon_validators.nim:587) is a semi-trusted boundary (authenticated JWT, co-located EL-CL) per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json trust_assumptions.engine_api. Exploitation requires a compromised or buggy local EL to send malformed blobsBundle, placing the prerequisite attack outside the security model. This is a correctness bug in input validation at a semi-trusted boundary, not a security vulnerability exploitable by external attackers within the defined bug bounty scope.
